label: M9-transferred slopes + reconstructed ramp + derived intercepts, zero transition premium

files.hash_convention: sha256 of the content, CRLF normalized to LF

base.description: climatology (TRY window), offset 0, lag 1 h, ramp scaler W9

rampWT.description: as base, ramp standardized on W_T

zW9.description: z re-standardized on W9 (mean 0.092361, sd 1.052863); climatology of the rescaled z

observed.description: climatology, observed z at t_v - 2 h .. t_v

ramp_scaler.definition: r_t = (dz_t - m_r) / s_r with dz_t = z_t - z_(t-1h) computed on the complete hourly UTC grid (dz_t undefined unless both labels t and t-1h are observed); transition S_(t-1) -> S_t uses x_(t-1) = (z_(t-1h), r_(t-1h))
ramp_scaler.status: ASSUMED/RECONSTRUCTED: the original M9 construction of RD_Ramp_1h_lag1 (difference direction, lag, raw RD vs z, standardization window, ddof) was not found in the repository, its git history, the SSRN manuscript or the calibration bundle; z.diff() on the complete hourly grid is a reconstruction and M9 is NOT claimed to be reproduced
